name: Nexagen Employee Wellness Polo
description:
Issued to all Nexagen Genomics & Wellness Solutions customer-facing staff below the Director tier. A fitted polo shirt in the company's signature deep teal, with a subtle texture-woven logo on the left chest and a clean two-button placket. The fabric is a moisture-wicking synthetic blend with a slight sheen — it photographs well under the warm lighting of Nexagen's client consultation floors, which is not an accident. The collar stays crisp through a full shift. The fit is tailored: slim enough to look polished, loose enough to allow the kind of demonstrative gesturing that wellness consultants are trained to use.

This shirt communicates institutional trust. When you see it, you know you're dealing with someone who has been vetted, badged, and trained in Nexagen's proprietary client interaction protocols. Off the clock, employees often change immediately — the polo carries an undertow of performance that's hard to shake. On the black market, clean Nexagen polos occasionally circulate as social engineering props, which is why the embroidered lot codes on the collar hem are updated quarterly.
functionality: Embedded lot code in collar hem allows Nexagen HR systems to verify shirt authenticity and track which facility it was issued from.
what_it_says: You are a professional representative of a trusted institution. Or you are pretending to be.
manufacturer: Nexagen Genomics & Wellness Solutions (corponation internal issue)
story_hooks: A rogue Nexagen polo with a lot code that doesn't match any issued batch has been showing up in access logs at three different secure facilities.
A character is given a Nexagen polo by a contact and told it will get them into a specific building — they don't know the contact works for Nexagen security.
The quarterly lot code update has been delayed by six weeks with no explanation, and Nexagen's internal security team is quietly panicking.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, fitted polo shirt in deep teal that reads as corporate-clean and deliberately approachable. The garment sits at the intersection of professional polish and subtle performance wear—tailored enough to convey competence, relaxed enough to suggest accessibility. The moisture-wicking sheen catches light in a way that suggests investment in presentation.
physical_description.fit: Slim tailored cut—fitted through the shoulders and torso without constraint, allowing arm mobility for gesture-based client interaction. The cut subtly emphasizes posture and confidence while remaining comfortable enough for an 8-hour shift.
physical_description.primary_material: Moisture-wicking synthetic blend (likely polyester-elastane composite), engineered for performance under warm clinic lighting and designed to resist visible perspiration marks.
physical_description.texture: Smooth with subtle texture-woven pattern integrated into the weave itself—fine enough to be invisible from a distance but visible up close, adding depth without obvious visual noise. The fabric has a controlled sheen that photographs well under warm incandescent light.
physical_description.color_scheme: Signature deep teal (Nexagen brand color #0B4F6C equivalent), solid throughout with minimal pattern. The embroidered chest logo and quarterly-updated collar hem codes are rendered in muted gunmetal gray.
physical_description.closures: Clean two-button placket at the collar; buttons appear to be functional but the placket design suggests minimal adjustment is expected once fitted.
distinctive_features: Subtle texture-woven Nexagen logo on left chest—understated enough to suggest confidence rather than corporate loudness
Embroidered lot codes on interior collar hem (updated quarterly for authentication/black market tracking)
Collar stays integrated or reinforced to maintain crisp appearance through full shift
Moisture-wicking treatment optimized for warm consultation floor lighting
Hidden construction details suggesting garment is designed to photograph well under specific lighting conditions
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 luxury corporate issue—not available for purchase, only issued to vetted employees. The garment is aspirational for lower tiers but carries institutional markers that make it recognizable to security.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer is Nexagen-vetted, trained in proprietary protocols, and positioned at the client-facing interface of medical/wellness services. The polo signals institutional trust, professional training, and access to restricted spaces. Off-duty, it carries psychological weight—wearing it off-hours suggests either pride in employment or inability to mentally separate from work.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly broken-in when issued; professional maintenance is expected. Any visible wear (fading, pilling, loose threads) is generally replaced before it becomes noticeable. Black market specimens often show signs of heavy cleaning or attempted color-matching repairs.
